{{Virgo}}
Virgo 28 is the 280th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Virgo, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 40, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 10宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 280|Chapter 280]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152299}}.
